items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And I also met Rudy Rutherford, who was a fine clarinetist, around that time.

ctx.x: ...talking about Rudy Rutherford or Sonny Stitt, because they felt that they were a little more experienced. They both were four years older than I was. And so, he said, "But I like what you're doing." He says, "You come on in and don't pay anybody any attention; you just come in here and do your work," you know.
